repo_meta_data.description: MS Paint for the Mac. Native, free and open source: blank canvas at any size, drop one image onto another, crop, and mark up screenshots. Ships PaintKit, a UI-free drawing engine with no AppKit and no third-party dependencies: macOS 12+, and swift test runs it in a fresh clone with no Xcode.
